a: What do we pray for in the fifth petition?
x: …Himself to God, and the priests of old offered cattle and animals, the pious discharge and offer the “calves of their lips” to the Lord
which is the act of God’s free grace in Christ
It arises from genuine regret for our sins that the glory of the grace of the Lord may be exalted through us
With the prophets, sacrifice everywhere signifies the worship of God
